def diffcount(a,b):

# Probe 1: click center icon of top-left panel (12,12)
r1 = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':12,'col':12}])
d1 = diffcount(previous_frame, current_frame)
print('probe1 icon(12,12): changed=', d1)
if d1==0:

    r2 = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':32,'col':112}])
    d2 = diffcount(previous_frame, current_frame)
    print('probe2 (32,112): changed=', d2)
    if d2==0:
        # Probe 3: 4x scale (16,56)
        r3 = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':56}])
        d3 = diffcount(previous_frame, current_frame)
        print('probe3 (16,56): changed=', d3)
